results.label: Commercial banks' housing and bridging loans outstanding (monthly)

proposal.label: Commercial banks' housing and bridging loans outstanding (monthly)
proposal.value_column: Consumer Loans - Housing And Bridging Loans
proposal.rationale: Commercial banks' housing and bridging loans outstanding measures the stock of mortgage credit available to households. Higher loan availability increases purchasing power for home buyers, supporting higher transaction volumes and prices (sales). Similarly, increased demand from more credit availability puts upward pressure on rents. This is a direct measure of mortgage credit supply in the market.
